claim.en: In the 2022–2026 term Marek Kandra chairs the commission for the protection of public interest of the Lorinčík local council.
claim.sk: Marek Kandra je v období 2022–2026 predsedom komisie na ochranu verejného záujmu miestneho zastupiteľstva Lorinčík.

findings.identity: Official Lorinčík site lists Marek Kandra on the local council 2022–2026, the body he sits on now.
